```{r}
library(dada2); packageVersion("dada2")
```

```{r}
path <- "~/ADM_dada2/data" # CHANGE ME to the directory containing the fastq files after unzipping.
list.files(path)
```

```{r}
# Forward and reverse fastq filenames have format: SAMPLENAME_R1_001.fastq and SAMPLENAME_R2_001.fastq
fnFs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern="_1.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
fnRs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern="_2.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
# Extract sample names, assuming filenames have format: SAMPLENAME_XXX.fastq
sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs), "_"), `[`, 1)
```

```{r}
plotQualityProfile(fnFs[1:2])
```

```{r}
plotQualityProfile(fnRs[1:2])
```

```{r}
# Place filtered files in filtered/ subdirectory
filtFs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names
```

```{r}
out <- filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs, fnRs, filtRs, truncLen=c(250,200),
              maxN=0, maxEE=c(2,2), truncQ=2, rm.phix=TRUE,
              compress=TRUE, multithread=FALSE) # On Windows set multithread=FALSE (only needed for filterAndTrim)
head(out)
```

```{r}
errF <- learnErrors(filtFs, multithread=TRUE)
```

```{r}
errR <- learnErrors(filtRs, multithread=TRUE)
```

```{r}
plotErrors(errF, nominalQ=TRUE)
```
```{r}
dadaFs <- dada(filtFs, err=errF, multithread=TRUE) 
```

```{r}
dadaRs <- dada(filtRs, err=errR, multithread=TRUE)
```

```{r}
dadaFs[[1]]
```

```{r}
mergers <- mergePairs(dadaFs, filtFs, dadaRs, filtRs, verbose=TRUE)
# Inspect the merger data.frame from the first sample
head(mergers[[1]])
```

```{r}
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
dim(seqtab)
```

```{r}
# Inspect distribution of sequence lengths
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
```

```{r}
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method="consensus", multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)
dim(seqtab.nochim)
```

```{r}
sum(seqtab.nochim)/sum(seqtab)
```

```{r}
getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track <- cbind(out, sapply(dadaFs, getN), sapply(dadaRs, getN), sapply(mergers, getN), rowSums(seqtab.nochim))
# If processing a single sample, remove the sapply calls: e.g. replace sapply(dadaFs, getN) with getN(dadaFs)
colnames(track) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoisedF", "denoisedR", "merged", "nonchim")
rownames(track) <- sample.names
head(track)
```

```{r}
taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, "~/ADM_dada2/silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz", multithread=TRUE, tryRC=TRUE)
```

```{r}
taxa <- addSpecies(taxa, "~/ADM_dada2/silva_v138.2_assignSpecies.fa.gz")
```

```{r}
taxa.print <- taxa # Removing sequence rownames for display only
rownames(taxa.print) <- NULL
head(taxa.print)
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq); packageVersion("phyloseq")
```

```{r}
library(Biostrings); packageVersion("Biostrings")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2); packageVersion("ggplot2")
```

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}

meta <- read.csv("~/ADM_dada2/SraRunTable (3).csv", check.names = FALSE)
names(meta)
nom <- meta[["Sample Name"]][match(rownames(seqtab.nochim), meta$Run)]
head(nom)   # doit afficher "ArcGB5_16" "ArcGB5_15" ...
```


```{r}
samdf <- data.frame(
  Domain = ifelse(grepl("^Arc", nom), "Archaea", "Bacteria"),
  Core   = paste0("4573-", sub("^(Arc|Bac)GB([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)$", "\\2", nom)),
  Depth  = as.integer(sub("^(Arc|Bac)GB([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)$", "\\3", nom))
)
samdf$Temperature <- "Temperate"
samdf$Temperature[samdf$Core == "4573-13" & samdf$Depth > 9] <- "Moderately hot"
samdf$Temperature[samdf$Core %in% c("4573-19", "4573-16")] <- "Extremely hot"
rownames(samdf) <- samples.out
samdf
```


```{r}
all(rownames(samdf) == rownames(seqtab.nochim))   # doit afficher TRUE

ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows=FALSE),
               sample_data(samdf),
               tax_table(taxa))

ps_arch <- subset_samples(ps, Domain == "Archaea")
ps_arch <- subset_taxa(ps_arch, Kingdom == "Archaea")

ps_bact <- subset_samples(ps, Domain == "Bacteria")
ps_bact <- subset_taxa(ps_bact, Kingdom == "Bacteria")
```

```{r}
bact_runs <- rownames(samdf)[samdf$Domain == "Bacteria"]
top_b <- names(sort(colSums(seqtab.nochim[bact_runs, ]), decreasing=TRUE))[1:200]

t2 <- assignTaxonomy(top_b, "~/ADM_dada2/silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz", multithread=TRUE, tryRC=TRUE)
table(t2[, "Kingdom"], useNA="ifany")
```


```{r}
plot_richness(ps_arch, x="Depth", measures=c("Shannon", "Simpson"), color="Temperature") +
  ggtitle("Archaea")

```

```{r}
plot_richness(ps_bact, x="Depth", measures=c("Shannon", "Simpson"), color="Temperature") +
  ggtitle("Bacteria")
```

```{r}
ps.prop.arch <- transform_sample_counts(ps_arch, function(otu) otu/sum(otu))
ord.nmds.arch <- ordinate(ps.prop.arch, method="NMDS", distance="bray")
plot_ordination(ps.prop.arch, ord.nmds.arch, color="Temperature", shape="Core", title="Archaea - Bray NMDS")
```

```{r}
ps.prop.bact <- transform_sample_counts(ps_bact, function(otu) otu/sum(otu))
ord.nmds.bact <- ordinate(ps.prop.bact, method="NMDS", distance="bray")
plot_ordination(ps.prop.bact, ord.nmds.bact, color="Temperature", shape="Core", title="Bacteria - Bray NMDS")
```
```{r}
# Archées
top20.arch <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_arch), decreasing=TRUE))[1:20]
ps.top20.arch <- transform_sample_counts(ps_arch, function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU))
ps.top20.arch <- prune_taxa(top20.arch, ps.top20.arch)
plot_bar(ps.top20.arch, x="Depth", fill="Family") +
  facet_wrap(~Temperature, scales="free_x") + ggtitle("Archaea")
```
```{r}
table(tax_table(ps)[, "Kingdom"], useNA = "ifany")
ntaxa(ps_bact)
```

```{r}
top20.bact <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_bact), decreasing=TRUE))[1:20]
ps.top20.bact <- transform_sample_counts(ps_bact, function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU))
```
